description: This is the main module for the assistants API logic in a Python project, managing interactions with different LLM providers (OpenAI, Azure) including creating, retrieving, deleting assistants, handling threads, messages, and streaming support. It contains asynchronous and synchronous functions, heavy use of dependency injection, and external library integrations.
